theorems.name: Submission.dgoj_unitOrientation_of_injective
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid P), Injective F → 0 < (F.adjoint ∘L F).det ∧ ∀ ξ : MultiVector P n, (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, α (fun i => F (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) = Real.sqrt ((F.adjoint ∘L F).det) * ξ α) → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ (LinearMap.range (F : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
